question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: The passage is about the life and activities of Subhas Chandra Bose. He was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement against British colonial rule. Born on January 23, 1897, in Cuttack, Odisha, he had a great role to lead in World War II to fight against British rule. He was also a leader of Indian National Congress and became its president in 1938 and 1939. He had a conflict of thought with Mahatma Gandhi and was under house arrest by the British force. Later he fled India. This great man passed away in 1945.
